tasks.description: The login flow should be defined to ensure secure and seamless access to the customer portal. This includes determining the authentication methods and authorization protocols. The definition should be based on industry best practices and security standards.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid username and password, when the user attempts to log in, then they are successfully authenticated and redirected to the portal dashboard.

tasks.description: The types of reports that will be available in the customer portal need to be listed. This includes determining the data sources and the reporting formats. The list should be based on customer requirements and business needs.
acceptance_criteria: Given a list of report types, when the user selects a report, then the corresponding data is displayed in the correct format.

tasks.description: The notification settings for the customer portal need to be described. This includes determining the types of notifications, the notification channels, and the user preferences. The description should be based on customer requirements and business needs.
acceptance_criteria: Given a set of notification settings, when the user updates their preferences, then the notifications are sent according to the updated settings.

tasks.description: The background section of the customer portal document needs to be written. This includes providing an overview of the portal's purpose, scope, and goals. The background should be based on business requirements and customer needs.
acceptance_criteria: Given the background section, when the document is reviewed, then the section provides a clear and concise overview of the portal.

tasks.description: The acceptance criteria for the customer portal need to be defined. This includes determining the test cases, the test data, and the test environments. The acceptance criteria should be based on customer requirements and business needs.
acceptance_criteria: Given a set of acceptance criteria, when the portal is tested, then the test results meet the defined criteria.
